task: Create a network topology diagram at /home/user/Documents/network_topology.drawio. Create 6 shapes labeled: Internet (cloud), Firewall, Switch, Web Server, App Server, Database Server. Connect sequentially: Internet->Firewall->Switch, then Switch to each server. The diagram must have 6 vertices and 5 edges. Save the file.
task_grounding: Open the file /home/user/Documents/network_topology.drawio in draw.io Desktop. Create a network topology diagram. Create exactly 6 shapes with these labels: 'Internet' (use a cloud shape if possible), 'Firewall', 'Switch', 'Web Server', 'App Server', and 'Database Server'. Connect them with arrows as follows: Internet -> Firewall, Firewall -> Switch, Switch -> Web Server, Switch -> App Server, Switch -> Database Server. The diagram should have exactly 6 vertices and exactly 5 edges. Save the diagram.

verification.description: Diagram file exists at expected path
